name: Homestyle Chicken Noodle Soup (Chickpea Pasta)
steps: Simmer the chicken, vegetables, garlic and thyme in the broth for 20 minutes.
Remove and shred the chicken.
Cook the pasta in the soup for 6 to 8 minutes.
Return the chicken and finish with parsley.

name: Broccoli Cheddar Soup
steps: Sauté the onion and garlic in oil.
Add the broccoli and broth and simmer 15 minutes.
Blend partly smooth, stir in the milk and mustard.
Melt in the cheddar off the heat.

name: Minestrone with White Beans
steps: Sauté the onion, carrot, celery and garlic in oil.
Add tomatoes, broth, beans and seasoning and simmer 20 minutes.
Add zucchini and kale for the last 8 minutes.
Serve with grated parmesan.

name: Creamy Tomato Soup with Basil
steps: Sauté the onion and garlic in oil.
Add the tomatoes and broth and simmer 15 minutes.
Blend smooth, stir in cream and basil.

name: Turkey and Vegetable Soup
steps: Brown the turkey with the onion in oil.
Add the broth, vegetables, tomatoes and seasoning.
Simmer 25 minutes.

name: Smoky Black Bean Soup with Lime Yogurt
steps: Sauté the onion, pepper and garlic in oil with cumin.
Add the beans and broth and simmer 20 minutes.
Blend half for body.
Serve with a spoon of yogurt, lime and cilantro.

name: Beef and Barley Stew
steps: Brown the cubed beef in oil.
Add the onion, tomato paste, broth and thyme and simmer 1 hour.
Add the barley, carrot and celery and cook 30 minutes more.

name: Old-Fashioned Split Pea and Ham Soup
steps: Combine everything in a pot.
Simmer 70 minutes, stirring, until the peas collapse.
Remove the bay leaf and season with pepper.

name: Loaded Cauliflower Mash
steps: Steam the cauliflower with the garlic until very tender.
Blend with butter, yogurt and salt.
Top with cheddar and chives.

name: Roasted Brussels Sprouts with Bacon
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Halve the sprouts and toss with oil, salt and pepper.
Roast with the chopped bacon for 25 minutes.
Finish with balsamic.

name: Southern-Style Green Beans
steps: Crisp the turkey bacon and set aside.
Cook the onion and garlic in the pan.
Add the beans, broth and vinegar and simmer 20 minutes.
Top with the bacon.

name: Collard Greens with Smoked Turkey
steps: Sauté the onion and garlic in oil.
Add the chopped collards, turkey, broth and pepper flakes.
Simmer 40 minutes until tender.
Brighten with vinegar.

name: Oven-Baked Sweet Potato Fries
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Cut the sweet potato into thin sticks and toss with oil and spices.
Roast 25 to 30 minutes, turning once.

name: Taqueria-Style Cilantro Lime Cauliflower Rice
steps: Sauté the garlic in oil.
Add the cauliflower rice and cook 5 minutes.
Stir in lime juice, cilantro and salt.

name: Corn and Black Bean Salsa Salad
steps: Combine the corn, beans, tomato, onion and jalapeno.
Dress with lime juice and oil.
Fold in cilantro and chill briefly.

name: Garlic Roasted Broccoli with Lemon
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F.
Toss the broccoli with oil, garlic and salt.
Roast 18 to 20 minutes.
Finish with lemon and parmesan.

name: Creamed Spinach
steps: Wilt the spinach with butter and garlic.
Stir in cream cheese and milk until smooth.
Add parmesan and nutmeg.

name: Cheesy Zucchini Boats
steps: Halve the zucchini and scoop out the centres.
Brown the turkey with the onion and chopped zucchini flesh.
Stir in marinara and fill the boats.
Top with cheeses and bake at 400°F for 20 minutes.

name: Stuffed Portobello Mushrooms
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F and brush the caps with oil.
Mix the wilted spinach, ricotta, garlic and sun-dried tomato.
Fill the caps and top with mozzarella.
Bake 18 to 20 minutes.

name: Vegetarian Black Bean Burgers
steps: Mash the beans with oats, egg, onion and spices and shape four patties.
Pan-fry in oil 5 minutes a side.
Serve in lettuce with tomato and avocado.

name: Eggplant Parmesan Stacks
steps: Slice the eggplant and dip in egg, then almond flour.
Bake on an oiled tray at 425°F until golden, 20 minutes.
Stack with marinara and mozzarella.
Bake 12 minutes more and finish with basil and parmesan.

name: Cauliflower Mac and Cheese
steps: Boil the pasta and cauliflower florets together until tender; drain.
Warm the milk, cream cheese, mustard and paprika.
Melt in the cheddar.
Fold in the pasta and cauliflower and bake 10 minutes at 400°F.

name: Lentil Sloppy Joes
steps: Simmer the lentils in the broth until tender, 20 minutes.
Sauté the onion and pepper and add the sauce, paste, mustard, vinegar and chili.
Combine and simmer 10 minutes.
Spoon over toasted muffins.

name: Chopped Italian-Style Salad with Chickpeas
steps: Chop the romaine, cucumber, tomatoes and onion.
Add the chickpeas, mozzarella and olives.
Whisk the vinegar, oil and seasoning and toss through.

name: Cobb Salad
steps: Grill and slice the chicken; hard-boil and slice the eggs; crisp the bacon.
Arrange the romaine on a platter with rows of each topping.
Whisk the oil, vinegar and mustard and drizzle.

name: Wedge Salad with Yogurt Blue Cheese Dressing
steps: Cut the iceberg into wedges.
Blend the yogurt, blue cheese and lemon into a dressing.
Top with tomatoes, crisp bacon and onion.

name: Apple Walnut Chicken Salad
steps: Shred the chicken and dice the apple and celery.
Mix with yogurt, lemon and mustard.
Fold in the walnuts and serve on the greens.

name: Taco Salad with Ground Turkey
steps: Brown the turkey in oil with taco seasoning.
Arrange the romaine, beans and tomato in bowls.
Add the turkey, cheddar and avocado.
Top with salsa mixed with yogurt.

name: Spinach Salad with Warm Bacon Dressing
steps: Crisp the bacon and keep a spoonful of fat.
Whisk in vinegar, mustard and oil for a warm dressing.
Toss with the spinach, mushrooms and onion.
Top with sliced boiled egg and bacon.

name: West Coast Shrimp Louie Salad
steps: Poach the shrimp 3 minutes and cool.
Arrange the romaine, avocado, tomatoes and sliced eggs.
Stir the yogurt, tomato paste and lemon for a pink dressing.
Top with shrimp.

name: Southwest Chicken Chopped Salad
steps: Season the chicken with chili powder and cumin and grill; slice.
Chop the romaine and combine with corn, beans, tomatoes and avocado.
Whisk the lime juice and oil and toss with the chicken and cilantro.
